title: The Train Back
summary: A quiet ride home across the causeway at dusk, then the stores hatch before nineteen hundred.
goal: They've had a quiet ride together and handed in their paper before nineteen hundred.
howToPlay: Quiet and short. Two lines, then let them talk. **Then their paper goes in, the way they chose.**

intro.where: The island train across the causeway at dusk, then the stores hatch.
intro.readAloud: The island train is four short carriages, half empty at this hour. Out of the window the city's lights are coming on behind you, and the causeway runs out ahead across the water.

position.note: On the island train, then at the stores.

cast.label: Nobu
cast.role: Closing the stores hatch for the night.

brief.wants: To shut the hatch and go home.

voice.register: Fast, as ever, and not reading what he's handed.

beats.text: Read the light, then let them talk. A quiet ride is fine.
beats.readAloud: The light through the window has gone long and orange. Nobody needs anything from any of you for about twenty minutes.

beats.text: If a player wants a moment of their own, ask what it is. They roll a skill they can argue for, then tell it.

At the stores hatch, Nobu takes their paper without reading it. File it the way they chose. <trig id="nobu-at-the-hatch"/> <trig id="docket-requisition-in"/> <trig id="docket-in-time"/> <trig id="close-docket"/>
beats.readAloud: "A vial? Medical countersigns those. It'll go up tonight. Next."
beats.note:
If they chose quietly: The receipt goes in Vetch's pigeonhole, and nobody else knows.
If they chose loudly: It's read out in the queue and pinned to the section board.
If they have no requisition: They hand in the docket or a receipt instead.
If they're late: The hatch is shut. They hand it to Vetch in person, and go on report.
Secret: Whatever paper of theirs goes in tonight, Rand finds it and countersigns it.

transition.line: The supper bell, and the Long Hall.

writeDown: Anything said on the ride worth calling back.
What they handed in, and how.

position.note: Back on the island, heading for supper.

temptations.text: Someone asks whoever talked to Manako most: what was he actually like?

reactionPrompts.text: The six talking among themselves on the ride.

notes: The episode's breather after the city. Its one job is the deadline: their paper goes in before nineteen hundred. Vials are Medical's, so a vial requisition goes up to Shucks's desk, where Rand reads everything at night.
